meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划自动跑完,并行分工并留存每一步执行证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有写好的工作计划,想让多个子任务并行落地并留下记录。
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan end to end with parallel subtasks and recorded evidence.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a written work plan and want its subtasks run in parallel.

howto.what: 它会变成只做调度、不碰产品代码的协调者:读取 .omo/plans 下的计划,把每个复选框拆成原子子任务,并行派给子代理执行,自己只负责选计划、派活、判卷,并维护 Boulder 状态、证据账本和每阶段独立 worktree。
howto.when: 当你说 ulw-execute,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的某个计划时触发;若没有可用计划而你说 start work,它会先调用 ulw-plan 生成计划再执行。

say.note: 自动选中该计划并开始拆解派发
阶段通过验证后推分支开 PR,不自动合并
开 PR 后盯 CI 与评审,合并后清理 worktree

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator that writes no product code: it reads a plan under .omo/plans, splits each checkbox into atomic sub-tasks, and dispatches them to parallel subagents, keeping only plan selection, dispatch, verdicts, Boulder state, an evidence ledger, and a per-wave worktree.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say ulw-execute or ask to run a plan in .omo/plans. If no plan is available and you say start work, it first runs ulw-plan to create one before executing.

say_en.note: Selects that plan and starts dispatching.
Delivers each phase as a pull request; merges only if you ask.
Keeps going until the PR is merged.
